The BOOKED INBOUND dock appointments at a site whose door window STARTS in the half-open window [window_start, window_end), read from the LOCAL read model this service builds from dock-scheduling's DockAppointmentBooked / Rescheduled / Cancelled / NoShow CloudEvents (docs/adr/0017, source switched by docs/adr/0020; never a live call). A rescheduled appointment counts at its new window; a cancelled or no-show one never counts, whatever the arrival order of the events (the producer's aggregate `version` is the ordering guard). OUTBOUND appointments are never counted. `labour_minutes` is what the standard declared for `path_id` attributes to them; with no standard it is 0 and `standard_missing` is true when appointments exist. Each appointment is attributed to the `site_id` of its events, so `location` is that site code; a site with no appointment reads 0. 200 with appointments 0 and as_of null when nothing is known.
